notes: GOLD v2 fixer round 1 (2026-10-18), sc_c1d112196ae5, part 48340007, full part, t ~1.9 mm, ~41x38 mm main plate (patches 1/2). Four real formed bends under the owner rule of 2026-10-18 (formed bends >= 10 deg count). All four turn down from the plate, so the outer skin is the top skin. Each was checked on perpendicular sections. B1: the long side flange 3/4, 90 deg, about 8 mm deep, full plate width. B2: the corner tab 8/10 with one hole, 90 deg, about 12 mm deep, about 9 mm wide. B3: the side tab 7/9 with two holes, 90 deg, about 10 mm deep, about 15 mm wide. B4: the shallow formed bend between the plate and the end panel 5/6 (panel about 7.8 mm deep). It measures 10.7 deg on the top skins 2/6 and 11.0 deg on the bottom skins 1/5. Its crease is straight and parallel to B1 (0.4 deg). The curved zone is about 3 mm wide and centred on the plane intersection. The top-skin cross-profile is the same at six stations from t = 1 to 17.6 mm, so the angle holds across the full panel width of about 19.2 mm. More than 3 mm from the crease, the plate side is flat within 0.3 deg and the panel side is flat at 10.5-11.0 deg. This makes it a formed press-brake bend, not a rolled kink. Before the 10 deg rule it was excluded (old rule: 15 deg). Not bends: the two plate holes, the U-shaped cut-out, tab hole walls and embosses, the plate-corner ear beyond the B1 flange-end relief, and thickness/perimeter edges. The 4 bends match the legacy count of 4.

bends.note: plate top skin 2 to outer face 4 of the long side flange (90 deg, outer skin = top/outer). Fold runs the full flange length.
plate top skin 2 to outer face 10 of the corner tab with a hole (90 deg). Fold spans the tab width ~9 mm.
plate top skin 2 to outer face 9 of the side tab with two holes (90 deg). Fold spans the tab width ~15 mm.

plate top skin 2 to top skin 6 of the end panel: 10.7 deg formed bend (bottom skins 1/5 give 11.0 deg), panel turns down, so the convex top skin is the outer skin. Straight crease parallel to B1 across the full panel width ~19.2 mm.
